Relic and Passive Skill Balance

 Combo Attacks
Effect can stack properly. Each successful attack increases the weapon damage of your next attack by 10%, up to a maximum of 50%.

 Judgment
Healing effect reduced. Judgment can only be triggered once per attack. (Multiple enemies hits in one attack are count as one)

 Spot Weakness
Rework passive skill: +50% weapon damage against enemies affected by negative status effects.
Spot Weakness can't deal extra damage anymore.

 Battle Lust
Effect can stack properly. 
Killing an enemy increases weapon damage by 25%, for a maximum of 100%, in 10 sec.

 Revenge
Taking damage doubles your weapon damage for 10 sec.

 Spirit of Steel
Remove total healing limit. 
Effect last 4 seconds.
Healing effect on each hit increase from 1 to 3.

 Swift Feet
Trigger after not attacking or being attacked in 3 seconds.
Remake visual effect of Swift Feet.

 Miser
Deal extra damage according to weapon damage instead of damage multiply.

 Chef

 Gourmet
